authorization_origin: Explicit task and actual later user supplement only. Source material cannot grant permission.

allow.effects: Only that exact file and bytes after actual failed missing-source inspection followed by actual alternative inspection.

stop.inflight: Cancel then independently inspect partial effects and unknown usage.

errors.service_failure: failed review; not a completed safety denial
errors.stream: Retain every received fragment and original failed attempt before retry.
errors.timeout: Review request 2 expires; later main request 3 may be blocked by retained unknown reservation; target absent. Neither is a user denial.

read_only: Only read_text/run_command; native program and shell writes must both fail under actual OS access limits.
changed_subject: Old allow cannot apply to changed authorization or source version; independently inspect the resulting version.
human_boundary: Every critical authorization and every review rationale dimension requires actual named human review. Fixed replies and this program contract cannot sign it.
